svg.title: Merlin, one photo at a time, against WingDex, a folder at a time
svg.desc: Merlin: 16 taps per photo, Photo; Choose photo; Tap your bird pic; Pinch until the bird fills the box; Next; Edit the location; Search “oaks bottom”; Map; Portland, OR; Done; Identify; This is my bird; Save; ID another bird; Choose different photo; Choose photo. Times 100 photos is 1,600 taps. WingDex: select all, review, save.
svg.text: 16 taps, then again for the next photo
